name: הֲדַסָּה
summary: Hadassah is the name by which Esther is introduced when Mordecai takes his orphaned cousin as his daughter.

evidence.note: The narrator identifies Hadassah as Esther and describes how Mordecai brought her up after her parents died.

note: The name has the consonants of הֲדַס ‘myrtle’ with a feminine ending. Esther 2:7 gives both personal names without interpreting either.
